# ORBIT ACADEMY — An Immersive Space Science Learning Platform

Orbit Academy is an interactive, NASA-inspired space science learning platform designed to transform how students explore, understand and experience the universe. Instead of relying solely on traditional textbooks and static lessons, Orbit Academy brings space science to life through immersive 3D solar system exploration, interactive planetary discovery, educational modules, climate science simulations, creative drawing tools and spacecraft-building experiences.

The platform aims to integrate NASA's open scientific resources and mission data to make authentic space research more accessible and engaging. Students can explore planets and their moons, understand planetary environments, learn about space missions, test their scientific knowledge through quizzes and develop creativity through interactive experiences.

Orbit Academy addresses the challenge of making complex scientific concepts understandable, engaging and accessible to younger generations. By combining 3D visualization, gamification, interactive learning and real-world space science, it seeks to inspire curiosity, encourage scientific thinking and empower the next generation of explorers, scientists and innovators.

Project Details — ORBIT ACADEMY

Orbit Academy is an immersive, interactive space science education platform designed to make learning about the universe engaging, visual and accessible. It combines scientific information, 3D experiences, interactive simulations, gamification and creative tools in one unified educational environment.

How it works:
Students can explore an interactive 3D solar system, discover planets and their moons, learn about planetary science, investigate space weather and climate, and experience educational activities through dedicated modules. The platform includes Discovery Mode, Learning Portal, Draw Mode, Climate Lab, Quiz Mode, Build Mode and Mars Rover Game. NASA's open-data resources and APIs, including APOD, DONKI, NASA Trek and OSDR, are used or targeted to bring authentic scientific information and space research into the learning experience.

Benefits and intended impact:
Orbit Academy makes complex scientific concepts easier to understand through visualization and hands-on exploration. Gamified learning, quizzes, achievements and interactive activities encourage curiosity, creativity, problem-solving and independent learning. Its long-term goal is to inspire students to pursue astronomy, space science, engineering and scientific research.

Technology and tools:

  • Frontend development: TypeScript, JavaScript and Vite-based development.
  • Development environment: Google Antigravity IDE.
  • Scientific resources: NASA Open APIs, NASA Trek and NASA OSDR.
  • Interactive experience: 3D visualization, animation, responsive UI and interactive simulations.
  • Version control: Git and GitHub.

Creativity and innovation:
The main innovation is bringing multiple space-science experiences together rather than presenting information through conventional lessons. Students can move from observing a planet to learning its scientific properties, testing their knowledge, creating space artwork and designing spacecraft within one platform.

Design considerations:
We considered scientific accuracy, accessibility for children, ease of navigation, responsive design, performance, interactive engagement and the responsible use of authentic scientific data.

Orbit Academy aims to turn students from passive readers into active explorers, creators and future innovators.
